not_available_modules.energetic_network_embeddings: PSF and bond-only connectivity require matching CHARMM parameter files or a serialized OpenMM System XML

planner_acceptance.coverage_contract: Every enabled and available default-off method has at least one planner task; enabled unavailable methods have an explicit reason and no task.

execution_acceptance.resume_contract: The first pass generated common-PCA identities; the documented uniform-weight control was then generated and the hash-verified workflow resumed to completion.

finding_picker_acceptance.contract: Unavailable methods are audited with zero candidates and are not converted into findings or significance claims.

interpretation: This is a bounded single-fixture software and reporting acceptance test. It validates planner coverage, availability gates, report ingestion, descriptive finding selection, and dashboard visibility; it does not establish convergence, biological mechanism, affinity, or transferability to other systems.
